observations: Photo shows a disassembled manual transmission/gearbox unit, heavily soiled with grease, dirt, and surface oxidation.
Wiring harness connectors and sensor plugs are dangling, disconnected from the bellhousing.
A watermark reads 'POSTED ON... NEMZ AUTOSPARE PARTS INVT' which identifies the seller's shop, not the part's brand or vehicle fitment.
No manufacturer markings, part numbers, or vehicle-specific casting text are legible anywhere on the housing.
Background shows other engine/drivetrain parts and a person's leg, suggesting a scrapyard or spare-parts shop setting.
Gearbox shows no visible cracks in the casing from this angle, but internal condition (gears, synchros, bearings) cannot be seen.

claims.claim: Direct tokunbo (foreign used, not locally removed)
claims.evidence: No import documentation, shipping tag, or container photo provided; cannot confirm origin from the casing alone.
Photo 0 shows disconnected wiring and a dangling sensor, which is inconsistent with a fully intact, ready-to-install unit; internal gear/synchro condition cannot be seen.

claims.claim: Buy fix and drive and enjoy
claims.evidence: No test video, spin test, or shift-through-gears clip to show the box turns freely or shifts properly.

risks.risk: Internal gear/synchro/bearing wear or damage not visible externally
risks.proof: Video of gearbox being manually rotated at input/output shaft and shifted through all gears, showing smooth engagement without grinding

risks.risk: Vehicle make/model/engine fitment unknown, affecting value and usability
risks.proof: Clear photo of any stamped part number or casting code on the housing, or seller statement matched to a visible VIN-linked tag
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic unidentified unit, lowest comparable tier

risks.risk: Missing or damaged internal components given exposed, disconnected harness
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the full wiring harness, clutch fork, and slave cylinder area showing all parts present and undamaged

risks.risk: Casing cracks or weld repairs hidden under dirt/grease
risks.proof: Photos after cleaning, from multiple angles including underside

risks.risk: Fluid contamination or metal shavings inside, indicating prior failure
risks.proof: Photo/video of drained gearbox oil showing color and any metal debris

proof_requests: Video of the gearbox shafts being turned by hand and shifted through gears
Close-up photo of any stamped part/casting number on the housing for vehicle fitment confirmation
Photos of the unit cleaned, showing all mounting faces and the casing for cracks
Photo of drained transmission fluid condition
Clear photo or document showing import/tokunbo origin
response.reason: The item is identifiable by type as a used manual gearbox, but 'fully intact' and functional claims are unverified and fitment is unknown, so it must be priced at worst case (non-functional, unidentified fitment) until proof is provided.
